name: Loli Maso
source:
The teacher who is supposed to control the students gives in to the cruel physical punishment which was offered by a young girl.

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE044937.html]DLSite[/url]]
translation:
本该管教学生的教师，竟在一名年幼少女施加的残酷体罚下彻底屈服。
